question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dissappoint"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Disappoint". (निराश करना)

 
 
• **Example: **His failure to appear on time did not disappoint me.
 
 
 
• **"Disappoint"** means to fail to fulfill someone's hopes or expectations. (निराश करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The movie did not disappoint the audience; it was fantastic.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Seize** (पकड़ना): To take hold of something suddenly and forcibly.

 
 
• **Example:** The police managed to seize the stolen goods.
 
 
 
• **Rebuke** (फटकार): To express sharp disapproval or criticism.
 
 
• **Example: **She rebuked him for being late.
 
 
 
• **Foresee** (पूर्वानुमान): To be aware of beforehand; predict.
 
 
• **Example:** He could not foresee the consequences of his actions.
